items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Then we had a place out there in Sue's Band. Ridley was waiting out there. ... B.B. Ridley. B.B. was playing drums. Was it near Jack Sheen's place? Yeah, there in Sue's Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then when he brought that long-necked band in there, he was a band. He had two people. He had one on them, you know. Mm-hmm. He saw that he was making of a outstanding band. They let him, you know, use him, you know, demonstrate. Man, what you got there, man? I don't know, but I'm going to try it out tonight. I said, well, you got the other guitar? Oh, yeah, I got it. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . you know, Renee was waking up at the…

Why, that's it. Yeah, I did see one one time. I was looking for Rene, and I went to this Cadillac Club down on St. Claude, and they had one there, you know. But I never paid attention to it, you know. I'd rather listen to the music and find the girls later.
